About Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah: 
----------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired by the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story evolves around happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues that are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' (Dilip Joshi), an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta' (Sailesh Lodha), is his neighbour. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' (Disha Wakani) and a mischievous son 'Tapu' (Bhavya Gandhi). Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble for all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son, he calls his father 'Champaklal' (Amit Bhatt) from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.title: Full Day Of Delhi’s Best Food In ₹1000?! 🤯🔥
snippet.description:
A full day of eating in Delhi on just ₹1000 — and somehow this city still delivered big flavour without breaking the budget. From a classic old-Delhi style breakfast to some iconic spots across the capital, this one was a proper DCT-style food run.

The morning began with crispy, hot bedmi pooris paired with hearty sabzi — the kind of breakfast that immediately sets the tone for the day. Lunch took me to Khan Market, where a punchy masala shikanji and a melt-in-your-mouth mutton seekh roll reminded me why Delhi owns the North Indian grill game. As the city turned golden in the evening, I stopped by Humayunpur for some juicy momos that absolutely slapped.

And to wrap up the challenge, I ended the night at the OG Rajinder Dhaba with their iconic butter chicken and garlic naan — the happiest way to close a ₹1000 food day. Delhi never disappoints.

About CID:
-----------------
The first thrilling investigative series on Indian Television is one of the most popular shows on Crime And Mystery. Dramatic and absolutely unpredictable, C.I.D. has captivated viewers over the last eleven years and continues to keep audiences glued to their television sets with its thrilling plots and excitement. Also interwoven in its fast-paced plots are the personal challenges that the C.I.D. team faces with non-stop adventure, tremendous pressure, and risk, all in the name of duty. The series consists of hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection, and suspense. The protagonists of the serial are an elite group of police officers belonging to the Crime Investigation Department of the police force, led by ACP Pradyuman [ played by the dynamic Shivaji Satam ]. While the stories are plausible, there is an emphasis on dramatic plotting and technical complexities faced by the police. The plot throws up intriguing twists and turns at every stage to keep the officers on the move as they track criminals, led by the smallest of clues.

Bawarchi Restaurant is World famous when it comes to quality and quantity with the most reasonable pricing. snippet.title: 🇰🇷 Korean Street Food HEAVEN in Seoul Myeongdong & Gwangjang Market
snippet.description:
⭐⭐⭐ English subtitles are always available, just click the "CC" on the screen 😊

Hello, I'm Alin.
This installment of our food tour comes to Seoul, South Korea!

Myeongdong Night Market in Seoul, where the neon lights are flashing and the aroma is overflowing!
Flame steak, beef on the iron plate, drizzled with sauce and then flames rise, a double blow to the eyes and tastebuds! Classic Korean fried chicken, crispy skin covered in sweet and spicy sauce! Fish cake skewers and fried rice cakes with spicy sauce are a must-try when you're in Korea. Soft rice cakes with sweet and spicy sauce instantly activate the taste buds! The cheesy kimchi gochujang has the right blend of local and western cheeses!

Seoul's Gwangjang Market, the mecca of traditional Korean cuisine!
Raw marinated crabs with sweet crab meat as smooth as jelly! With traditional food stalls all over the market, experience the delicious flavors while getting into the atmosphere of native Korean food!
